description: This file defines the GrainVersioningOptions class, which contains configuration options for grain versioning strategies in Orleans, including default strategies for compatibility and version selection in heterogeneous deployments.

classes.name: GrainVersioningOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for grain versioning strategies, including default compatibility and version selection strategies.

methods.name: DefaultCompatibilityStrategy
methods.description: Property to get or set the name of the default strategy used to determine grain compatibility.

methods.name: DefaultVersionSelectorStrategy
methods.description: Property to get or set the name of the default strategy for selecting grain versions.
